'''Jason Makohon''' (also published as '''Jason Makohan''') designed [[Jason Makohon Ewoks|Ewoks]], a deck published on [[Torch Industries]].<ref name="torch">[http://members.aol.com/drtorch/Force.html Jason Makohon's Ewoks], Torch Industries (Paul Todd Feldman). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20000303224657/http://members.aol.com:80/drtorch/Force.html Internet Archive]</ref> He played Northern California and Las Vegas tournaments in 2000–2001, finishing 4th at the [[2001 California State Championship]].<ref name="tr-d2275" />
